body.statement: A response table \(f\) belongs to \(F_\kappa\) if and only if every directed simple cycle in \(G_{\kappa,f}\) has strictly positive total weight. Whenever this condition holds, the associated response patch contains an open axis-aligned cube in \(\mathbb R^J\).
body.justification: The cycle criterion makes every response type and every price breakpoint finite and auditable while preserving strict utility margins.
body.gap: Duarte et al. compile finite response functions into polynomial programs, but do not exploit affine price-cycle geometry to classify dynamic menu-turnover patches.
body.consumer: The criterion supplies the exact response-table enumerator used by every identification, approximation, and confidence-set result in this project.
